What it does

QuantDesk is the analytics half of the trading tools, without the committee theatre. Factor exposures, risk decomposition and screens, presented properly, with AI personas that interpret the same numbers from different investment philosophies.

It assumes competence. If you want the argument structured for you, Quorum is the better fit; QuantDesk is for someone who wants the factor data and their own conclusion.

Worth saying: Analytics and research. Not investment advice.

Questions people actually ask

Before you call

Do I need a quant background?

It helps. QuantDesk presents factor analytics on their own terms rather than translating them, which is the point for its users and the wrong tool for everyone else.
